name: Cosmic Path
tagline: Watch the comet. Remember its path. Trace it back. A visual memory game for brain training.
description: Cosmic Path is a visual memory game for brain training in deep space. Watch a comet trace a path across the grid, then draw it back from memory. Paths get longer, the grid gets bigger and new rules join one at a time - a decoy comet, paths traced backwards, lights out and portals that make the path jump across the board - while boss levels mix the rules into one long path. Daily Challenge with a streak, a Relax mode, Game Center leaderboards and achievements, 7 languages, no internet needed to play.

features.title: Campaign in three acts
features.description: Learn each rule, combine them, then master them all: a decoy comet, paths traced backwards, lights out and total darkness - each with a short lesson and a free try.

features.title: Portals and boss levels
features.description: The comet dives into one portal and comes out of another. Every few levels a boss mixes the rules into one long path - beat it for 10 stars.

features.title: 4 skills
features.description: Slow Time, Trail, Hint and Checkpoint. Slow Time, Trail and Checkpoint last 3 rounds - refill them with the stars you collect on the path.

features.title: Daily Challenge
features.description: 5 rounds with a new twist for every day of the week, the same for every player. Keep your streak alive.

features.title: Relax mode
features.description: Unlocks at level 15. Choose the grid, path length, speed and rules - no pressure, no internet needed.

features.title: Game Center & Play Games
features.description: 3 leaderboards, 10 achievements and cloud save. In 7 languages: English, Polish, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese and Italian.
